_help: Registry values applied by the Registry step. type is DWord, QWord, String, ExpandString, MultiString or Delete. Change any value, set a category's enabled to false to skip it, or add new entries. skipIfCritical skips an entry when one of its tags is critical; onlyIfCritical applies it only when one of its tags is critical.
